goal: Make the automatic production qualifier judge a merged pull request against main as it was before the merge, so a superseded REVISE on an earlier head no longer looks identical to the approved head, while every refusal rule stays fail-closed.
dispatcher: Albert Hazan chat request to fix #3146
prohibited_actions: No database write or structure change of any kind
Do not relax the rule that a durable refusal on a content-identical earlier head blocks a carry
assumptions: The qualifier runs after the merge with current main containing the source head; the merge commit first parent is main as the guarded merge judged it
stop_conditions: Stop if the fix would let any head carry an APPROVE the guarded merge would refuse
